risk_note: RV2 (risk + identity + growth + app.module). BR-ID-36 细则「规则清单的启停」 / D10-536 (a)(b): risk exports the rule-status reader (disabled off; enabled and the writers' legacy active on; no row on; config cache cycle, injected Clock; per app). Decision points read it once before deciding and pass the judgement on: identity sms-codes blocked prefix (SMS_BLOCKED_PREFIX) and registration device limit (DEVICE_REGISTER_LIMIT) record through recordDecidedHit; registration blocklist matches carry an app-scoped decision token to recordHits; growth first-app-login-review (inv_09_same_device) does not unbind the inviter when the rule is off and writes its hit with decided_in_force. Hit writers no longer re-read on these paths, so a refusal or unbinding always has its risk_hits row (money r1 S1 ×2). order-blocklist accepts the same optional field for the orders line (not wired yet; S2 follow-up to w1). identity / growth keep no cache of their own. Round-2 code moved from B1-03zg per D10-536. Full verification on the AWS test machine with PROP_RUNS=2000 green (exit 0); required CI checks run on the PR head.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1 ×2: judgement and hit write read the rule status twice; a cache expiry between them refused / unbound with no hit), fixed in round 2; round 2 pass with one S2 (orders path, not wired) recorded for w1 (couli-runs/B1-03zh/review-money-r1.json, r2); Codex unavailable until 11-02 (approvals #36)

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by independent Claude through claude-run.sh (attempt 1; attempt 2 decision-hit-race for money r1); r1 pass, r2 pass with one S2 (no separate caches, built into the implementation) (couli-runs/B1-03zh/review-spec-r1.json, r2); final spec red PASS 22 tests in 6 files

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
